# scm_dlp_data_profile_list (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of DLP Data Profiles (`GET /v2/api/data-profiles`), optionally filtered by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List DLP data profiles, optionally filtered by name.
data "scm_dlp_data_profile_list" "all" {}

data "scm_dlp_data_profile_list" "by_name" {
  name = "REPLACE_WITH_NAME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Optional profile name filter to find a specific data profile.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) List of matching data profiles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `total` (Number) Total number of profiles returned.
